title: RowPatchRequest
description: Request body for PATCH /api/data-sources/:id/rows/:rowId (HEL-1078). `data` is the row's complete new value -- a positional array the same length/order as the source's declared schema, not a partial/sparse update (design.md D2). `updatedAt` is the row's last-read `updated_at`; the write is rejected with 409 if it does not exactly match the row's current stored value.
